title: Assistant
clearConfirm: Erase the conversation? Everything the assistant has already done for you stays.

empty.title: Write what you need in plain words
empty.hint1: how do I invite a colleague to the space
empty.hint2: how do I change the language
empty.hint3: who can see my conversation with the assistant

trace.expired: The details are no longer stored

limit.title: The assistant’s limit in this space is used up
limit.shared: The limit is shared by all members of the space: everything the assistant did for each of them counts.

memory.title: Assistant memory
memory.hint: The assistant only remembers what you said yourself. Each space has its own memory; “Clear” in the chat does not erase it.

voice.denied: The microphone is blocked — allow it in the browser settings
voice.tooLong: Recording stopped: one minute at most

error.dailyLimitReached: The assistant’s daily limit in the space “{workspace}” is used up — it is shared by all members. New requests can be sent tomorrow
error.userDailyLimitReached: Your daily assistant limit is used up — it is shared across all your spaces. New requests can be sent tomorrow
error.monthlyLimitReached: The assistant’s monthly limit in the space “{workspace}” is used up — it is shared by all members. New requests can be sent next month
error.modelUnavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now, please try again later
error.transcriptionUnavailable: Speech recognition is not set up
error.audioTooLong: The recording is too long — one minute at most
error.unknown: Couldn’t reach the assistant, please try again
